expectations.text: Identifies the interim final rule (91 FR 55457) revising USML Category VIII(a)(8), effective October 13, 2026
expectations.evidence: "The October 13, 2026 rule (91 FR 55457) revises VIII(a)(8)"; comment period noted ("comments on the rule were due September 28, 2026"), consistent with an IFR.

expectations.text: States the effect: qualifying civil aircraft (FAA transport/commuter category) modified with 'secured ASE' are excluded from the USML — the aircraft itself moves to EAR jurisdiction
expectations.evidence: "carve out civil FAA transport/commuter category aircraft equipped with 'secured ASE'... the aircraft itself is excluded from Category VIII(a)(8)"; "potentially EAR/FAA export process for the airframe".

expectations.text: Defines secured ASE correctly: DIRCM systems (or IR/UV missile-warning systems necessary for DIRCM operation) incorporated with anti-tamper measures, per new §121.0 definitions
expectations.evidence: "defined in new § 121.0 as DIRCM systems, or the IR/UV missile-warning sensors needed to cue DIRCM, provided the installation incorporates anti-tamper protection".

expectations.text: States the critical nuance: the ASE equipment itself REMAINS on the USML in Category XI, and related technical data/defense services remain ITAR-controlled (XI(d))
expectations.evidence: "the DIRCM turret, sensor suite... remains separately controlled under Category XI(d)... All technical data and defense services tied to that ASE... stay ITAR-controlled under Category XI(d)".

expectations.text: Mentions the new §120.54 carve-outs: temporary import of secured ASE and country-to-country movement of previously authorized installed ASE no longer require separate authorization
expectations.evidence: "§ 120.54(a)(8) exempts temporary imports of secured ASE... § 120.54(a)(9) exempts country-to-country movement of previously licensed, installed secured ASE".
